pk.context: 5 mg/kg intravenous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear to opalescent solution in a single-dose vial

tell: A humanized IgG2 kappa antibody that can also break apart preformed P-selectin/PSGL-1 complexes.

clues.text: It is expected to be metabolized into small peptides by catabolic pathways, and hydroxyurea had no clinically meaningful effect on its pharmacokinetics.
Made by recombinant DNA technology in Chinese hamster ovary cells, with a theoretical molecular weight of about 146 kDa. Supplied as a sterile, preservative-free solution.
Approved under a BLA as a single-dose vial of 100 mg per 10 mL, given at weeks 0 and 2 and then every 4 weeks.
No boxed warning and no contraindications. Arthralgia and nausea are among the most common reactions.
Reducing the frequency of vaso-occlusive crises in patients aged 16 years and older with sickle cell disease.
Binds P-selectin and blocks its interactions with ligands such as PSGL-1, and can break apart preformed P-selectin/PSGL-1 complexes.
The generic name begins with C and has thirteen letters.
